title: GATHERING OF ESSENCE ~ Funky Monkey
short_description: A playful day of movement, dance, water, and community to reconnect with your inner child and the joyful spirit of the monkey. Enjoy embodied practices, ecstatic dance, nature, sauna, and a sound journey in a heart-centered gathering for all ages. 🐒🌿💧
description:
🐒 GATHERING OF ESSENCE ~ Funky Monkey

📆 Saturday 11.7. ~ 2pm - 11.45pm

📍Essência Nature Retreat (between Lagos & Aljezur) in our temple & outdoor space

🪷 Contribution: 17€ early bird (until 6.7.), 22€ normal (until 10.7.), 27€ at the door 

Bring one monkey friend for just 10€ when you buy your ticket online

🌳 Registration: <https://fienta.com/en/gathering-of-essence-funky-monkey>

⏳ Timetable:

🌀 2:00pm - Opening Circle

🦥 2:30pm - Funny & Playfull Body Practice  

🌊 3:30pm - Refreshing Water Dance 

❄️ 5:00pm - Forest SPA: Cold Tub, Natural Pond & Iced Soulfood

🐴 7:00pm - Animal Movement & Play 

🐵 7:30pm - Ecstatic Monkey Dance

✨ 9:00pm - Sound&Touch Journey and Closing

🔥 10:00pm - Late Night Sauna

Dear Friends, Dancers, Lightworkers, Families, Creators, Yogis & Water Beings,

🌊 We, the Essência Family invite You on a whole day journey to connect to our inner children and the power of the monkey which lives within us 

🐒 We will celebrate our inner joy, play, dance, embody our funkiness and connect from heart to heart 

🌊 During this journey the waters of our Land will cool us down. So bring your swimming clothes and jump with us in our natural pond, plunge in our cold tub and taste yummy iced soul food 

🐒 After our monkey dance in the evening we will offer you a Sound&Touch\~Journey and then open the doors of our Late\~Night Sauna to integrate the experiences of the day

🐞 Kids are warmly welcome. They can come for free. 

🛖 We use the income of the gathering to built the wooden deck of our community yurt. 

📷 We will take some videos during the gathering to create an aftermovie 

⛺️ With your tent, campervan or caravan you can stay for 10€ overnight 

✨ We are looking forward to welcome you and remember the joyfulness which is always available in us! 

🌳 The Essência Family
